let verse_count = Array.length verses in
if verse_count = 0 then ModernPoetry
else
let first_len = String.length verses.(0) in
match (verse_count, first_len) with
| 4, 7 -> QiYanJueJu
| 8, 5 -> WuYanLuShi
| _, 4 -> SiYanPianTi
| _ -> ModernPoetry
